caseName: Baby Boy Doe, a Fetus, by His Court-Appointed Guardian Ad Litem, Murphy, Cook County Public Guardian v. Mother Doe
caseNameFull: Baby Boy Doe, a Fetus, by His Court-Appointed Guardian Ad Litem, Murphy, Cook County Public Guardian v. Mother Doe. No. A-502

opinions.text:
Application for an order remanding the matter to the Circuit Court of Cook County, presented to Justice Stevens, and by him referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Blackmun would grant the application.
